themes_detail.label: Illegal Posting Surge
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 6 this week versus 0.6 weekly average over the prior 8 weeks—a 860% increase (z-score: 7.72)—suggesting a coordinated or sudden campaign affecting Upper East Side storefronts, transit stations, or public spaces.
evidence: 6 illegal posting complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Represents sharpest recent spike in 311 data after helicopter noise anomaly
reporting_angles: On-the-ground canvass: where are illegal postings concentrated (specific blocks, station areas, storefronts)?
Interview Dept. of Sanitation or transit authority on whether they've identified organized poster campaigns or vendors

themes_detail.label: Missing Street Signs Problem
themes_detail.summary: Street sign complaints jumped to 6 this week compared to 1.5 weekly average—a 300% spike—creating potential navigation and safety hazards for residents and drivers across Upper East Side.
evidence: 6 street sign complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Mirrors long-standing CB budget request for 'Repair or build new step streets' suggesting chronic street infrastructure neglect
reporting_angles: Map the specific blocks where signs are missing—are they clustered in one neighborhood or dispersed?
Interview DOT on response times and whether recent weather (snow/ice) or construction may have damaged signage

themes_detail.label: Elevated Lead Exposure Complaints
themes_detail.summary: Lead complaints rose to 21 last week versus 7.5 weekly average—a 180% increase (z-score: 4.22)—potentially indicating emerging awareness of lead in housing stock or water, critical for a district with older buildings and families with children.
evidence: 21 lead complaints last week vs. 7.5 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Community Board has repeated budget requests for 'Renovate or upgrade public housing developments' and 'Renovate interior building component' (DOE), suggesting unaddressed housing stock issues
reporting_angles: Investigate whether recent building alterations (1,653 alteration permits filed in last 90 days) have disturbed lead paint or plumbing
Interview residents, pediatricians, and HPD on whether lead testing awareness campaigns or school notifications triggered complaints
Cross-reference with public housing development locations to assess if NYCHA buildings disproportionately affected

themes_detail.label: Dead Animal Complaints Spike
themes_detail.summary: Dead animal reports jumped to 6 last week versus 1.4 weekly average—a 336% increase (z-score: 4.66)—suggesting possible rodent/pest outbreak, disease vector concern, or public health sanitation issue across the district.
evidence: 6 dead animal complaints last week vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Potential leading indicator of broader pest or animal population issue; convergence with unsanitary condition complaints (352 over 90 days)
reporting_angles: Investigate locations of dead animal reports: are they concentrated near parks, subway areas, or residential blocks?
Contact NYC Parks, MTA, and DOHMH on whether they've detected unusual animal mortality or disease patterns
Assess whether sanitation service gaps or recent construction may be creating attractants

themes_detail.label: Food Poisoning Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Food poisoning complaints surged to 7 two weeks ago versus 1.6 weekly average—a 331% spike (z-score: 4.84)—indicating potential foodborne illness outbreak linked to restaurants, street vendors, or institutional food services on Upper East Side.
evidence: 7 food poisoning complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Vendor Enforcement complaints also present (348 total over 90 days), suggesting potential street food safety concern
reporting_angles: Contact NYC Department of Health to request inspection records and violation data for Upper East Side restaurants and food vendors from past 2 weeks
Interview affected residents on which establishments/vendors they reported; identify if complaints cluster around one location or type of food
Investigate whether spike has since subsided or if outbreak is ongoing
